== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Temporary Foothold (Errata)]] (<code>1274_20</code>, Virtual Block 7.4 slip 04), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Temporary_Foothold.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-temporaryfoothold-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Temporary Foothold]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text in the VMasterType list. The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. The lore is the printed slip's (the CardMaker card data had the Decipher lore).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to 2 cards from Reserve Deck.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1274_20</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, slip number 7, original-title strip, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
